description: velasco, luis and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The collection contains synthetic in-phase/quadrature optical constellation samples for 16-QAM connections generated using a Matlab coherent WDM optical-system simulator. Coverage is simulated communications behaviour; the source does not establish that these are field-measured signals. Exact channel counts, perturbation labels, sample sizes and train/test splits are not stated in the short description. The data provide source-established inputs for optical-signal modelling and evaluation. Related optical digital-twin studies are not assumed to consume this exact version without explicit evidence. Zenodo provides the deposited collection and native file inventory with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. File descriptors were inspected; the contents were not downloaded or executed. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. Native file descriptors distinguish single-link and multiple-link ZIP components, each with a descriptive PDF; the linked README and archive bodies were not read.
